stories.title: S&P 500 sales growth hits a nearly five-year high
stories.summary: S&P 500 companies are posting sales growth at its fastest pace in roughly five years, according to MarketWatch. CNBC flags the trend as one of the key things to watch in the stock market this week, pointing to underlying revenue strength rather than just cost-cutting as a driver of recent gains.
stories.whyItMatters: Revenue growth (versus margin expansion alone) signals genuine demand strength, which matters for how sustainable the market's gains are.
whatToWatch: Upcoming earnings reports for confirmation of the trend
Analyst revisions to forward sales estimates
questions: Is the sales growth broad-based across sectors or concentrated in a few industries?
How long can the current pace be sustained?

stories.title: US stock futures dip as investors await inflation data amid Iran uncertainty
stories.summary: US stock futures slipped as traders positioned ahead of incoming inflation data while continuing to weigh unresolved uncertainty tied to Iran, per MarketWatch.
stories.whyItMatters: The inflation print will shape near-term Fed rate expectations, and unresolved Iran-related risk keeps a geopolitical premium on oil and equity volatility.
whatToWatch: Further developments on the Iran situation
questions: Will the inflation data come in hotter or cooler than expected?
How much of the futures dip is inflation-driven versus geopolitical caution?

sources.title: U.S. stock futures dip as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty

stories.title: The number of stocks beating the S&P 500 is the highest in 4 years. Why that number should rise.
stories.summary: The number of individual stocks outperforming the S&P 500 has climbed to its highest level in four years, MarketWatch reports, suggesting market gains are becoming less concentrated in a small group of mega-cap names.
stories.whyItMatters: Broader participation across stocks is generally seen as a healthier market signal than gains driven by a handful of giants.
whatToWatch: Sector rotation away from mega-cap leadership
questions: What's driving the broader participation now?
Is this shift durable or a short-term rotation?

stories.title: Oil rises amid uncertainty over US-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
stories.summary: Oil prices climbed as traders weighed continued uncertainty over a potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz tied to US-Iran talks, according to CNBC and Investing.com.
stories.whyItMatters: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical corridor for global oil shipments, so any disruption or resolution risk feeds directly into crude prices and, by extension, inflation expectations.
whatToWatch: Progress or breakdown of the US-Iran discussions
Follow-through in oil prices as details emerge
questions: What specific terms are being negotiated?
How much of the current price move is speculative versus based on confirmed developments?

stories.whyItMatters: Congressional race outcomes can shape the makeup of committees overseeing fiscal and regulatory policy, though this item is more political than market-moving.

stories.whyItMatters: The question reflects a common dilemma for retirees balancing safety and returns as they transition out of full-time work.

stories.title: Would marrying at 67 cost my girlfriend her SSI and divorced-spouse benefits?
stories.summary: MarketWatch's advice column takes on a reader's question about whether marrying his 67-year-old girlfriend would affect her Supplemental Security Income and divorced-spouse Social Security benefits.
stories.whyItMatters: Marriage can trigger changes to SSI eligibility and spousal benefit calculations, a key consideration for readers making retirement and financial-planning decisions.
questions: How exactly would marriage change her SSI eligibility?
Would she retain any divorced-spouse benefit after marrying?

stories.title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole over salmonella risk
stories.summary: Taylor Farms has recalled salsa and guacamole products due to a potential salmonella contamination risk, according to Investing.com.
stories.whyItMatters: Food-safety recalls can weigh on sentiment toward packaged-food suppliers and retailers carrying the affected products.
whatToWatch: Scope of the recall and any reported illnesses
Retailer response to pull affected products
questions: How widespread is the recall geographically and by product line?
Have any illnesses been confirmed?

stories.title: Japanese executives push for FX stability as weak yen squeezes import costs
stories.summary: Japanese business executives are calling for greater currency stability as a weak yen continues to drive up import costs, according to Investing.com.
stories.whyItMatters: A persistently weak yen shapes expectations for Bank of Japan policy and ripples through global FX and rate-sensitive trades.
whatToWatch: Any policy response from the Bank of Japan
questions: Will the BOJ intervene or adjust policy in response to these calls?
How much further could the yen weaken before policymakers act?

stories.title: Iran says Oman-brokered Hormuz deal is in 'final stages'
stories.summary: Iran says a deal mediated by Oman is nearing completion but insists the US must act before the Strait of Hormuz can reopen, according to Investing.com.
stories.whyItMatters: The Strait of Hormuz is central to global oil supply routes, so the deal's outcome directly affects crude prices and energy-market risk premiums.
whatToWatch: The US response Iran says is required
questions: What specific action is Iran demanding from the US?
What's the timeline for a resolution?

stories.whyItMatters: SK Hynix is a bellwether for memory-chip demand, so its chart action is watched as a read on broader semiconductor sentiment.
whatToWatch: Whether shares hold the Fibonacci support level
Completion or breakdown of the bear flag pattern
questions: What would confirm or invalidate the bearish pattern?
